author: claude
expected: Processing fails with a specific, actionable error saying rotated rasters are unsupported, not the generic 'Processing failed'. Record the exact text; the ticket says the UX wording is still being agreed, so a generic message is reported as FAIL against criterion 3 with that note.

preconditions.text: fixture present; sha256 recorded; its geotransform rotation/shear terms read and recorded before upload
CT account logged in on every target
test-data site a0000001 exists in the CT org on staging

requirement.text: A genuinely rotated GeoTIFF fails with an actionable error  - sync with UX about the new error taxonomy and getting a proper error message to the user.

steps.text: Deliver the fixture to the target: tablets via adb -s <serial> push into a test folder under Download; W044 via scp to webpc044
Open the authorized test site 'QA engine' (site a0000001, staging)
Maps page import flow (as tests/2026-10-09-terrain-resolution/tools/maps_import.py): pick the file, name it QA_<deviceTag>_CL80003_ROTATED, choose the site, Next (cloud write: one new dataset)
Wait for the server-side DSM processing: poll the dataset's status in the app and with a read-only API GET, up to a time limit set from source
Read the final status in the app (status label, any error text) and from the API; screenshot
Leave the app where it started (always)

steps_note: Run for test task 0000fake004 at the user's request (2026-10-22: 'do both'). Fixture: a clearly rotated GeoTIFF (rotation term well above 1e-12, e.g. 5 degrees) generated with the existing tests/2026-10-09-terrain-resolution/tools/geotiff_writer.py into the campaign folder; sha256 and generator parameters added when the case is completed.
title: Genuinely rotated GeoTIFF fails with a specific error (CL-80003)
